qualification: The customer access path is provider-backed E2E on staging. The 20-case gate is closed using a mix of observed staging/provider behavior, production-build evidence, and deterministic code invariants. Cases not individually fault-injected in staging are explicitly labeled CODE_INVARIANT rather than RUNTIME_OBSERVED.

cases.basis: Unauthenticated /app and protected asset routes redirected to /unlock; Premium body absent.
Unlock calls getVerluneAccessConfigState first and returns 503 without issuing session when required provider IDs/API key/secrets/config are absent or invalid.
Invalid/rejected license returned controlled 401 after remediation/retest and did not authorize Premium.
Correct key + wrong checkout email returned controlled 401; no extra activation consumed.
entitlementMatches rejects store_id, product_id, and variant_id mismatches before activation/session issuance; correct frozen identity succeeded in provider-backed staging.
Provider metadata required activation_limit=3; three active browser instances succeeded and fourth activation returned 409 while provider stayed 3/3.

Valid provider-backed unlock returned 200 and authorized /app. Session cookie options are HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production; signed payload contains keyed fingerprints/hashes and identifiers, not raw license key.
Authorized /app rendered exactly 17 launch-core customer surfaces including both Builders and both toolkit items.
Premium assets are private-build materialized; readPremiumAsset recomputes Git blob SHA and rejects identity mismatch before delivery. Prompt Builder protected body was opened successfully.
VERLUNE PREMIUM BUILD AUDIT PASS; 17 private launch-core assets, 8 protected routes, 15 public/static files scanned with no protected marker leak observed.

Signed session uses HMAC-SHA256; parser timing-safe compares signature and returns null on mismatch; requirePremiumSession redirects null sessions. Independent deterministic reproduction of the exact signing/parse algorithm rejected a one-character token mutation.

sessionNeedsRevalidation enforces 86400-second threshold. Forced revalidation exercised active, revoked, outage, and restore paths; stale outage token was hardened to validatedAt=0 so protected routes keep revalidating until success.
Disabled Test entitlement forced revalidation to session-invalid, cleared authorization semantics, blocked Premium, and rejected unlock while disabled.
Fault-injected provider/admin outage locked Premium, direct /app remained 307, retry state survived, restored provider revalidation returned to /app 200 without re-entering purchase details.
Logout returned 303; subsequent /app returned 307/locked while non-authorizing device reference remained available for reuse.
Same browser re-unlocked with same entitlement and provider activation stayed 1/3 rather than incrementing.
Deactivate returned 303; Lemon state changed Active 1/3 -> Inactive 0/3; later valid unlock restored Active 1/3.
On provider deactivation error, route redirects to /app/access?error=deactivation-unavailable without clearing authorization/device cookies; no false deactivation success is emitted, allowing retry.

newPremiumSession sets expiresAt = issuedAt + sessionMaxAgeSeconds; configured/default candidate is 604800 seconds. Parser rejects expired session and cookie maxAge cannot exceed remaining signed expiry.
Three distinct contexts reached Active 3/3; fourth browser unlock returned 409 and remained locked.

deterministic_invariant_checks.note: These deterministic reproductions independently checked the exact pure-logic contract observed in the repository; they are not represented as browser/provider runtime executions.
